title: Sitemap commerce sections still stop at 100 rows each with no second page, and help category pages carry no lastmod

source.ref: Remainder of SCAN-1226 (whole-site audit 2026-11-16, project thread, requested by Daniel), split out when the circles half shipped.

detail:
EVIDENCE: app/sitemap.ts COMMERCE_SITEMAP_CAP = 100. listShopProducts, listMarketListings (lib/commerce/products.ts) and listHousingListings (lib/listings/housing.ts) clamp the caller's limit to 100 and take no offset; listListings (lib/marketplace.ts) takes no offset either. The help category entries in app/sitemap.ts carry no lastModified.

WHY IT MATTERS: Past 100 store, market, housing or classified listings the oldest drop out of the sitemap with only a log line (atCap). Volumes are near zero today, so this is not a launch problem. Help categories lose the recrawl hint the pricing and door pages now have.

FIX DIRECTION: Give the four readers an offset or range and walk them the way getAllPublicCircles walks circles (SCAN-1226), then drop COMMERCE_SITEMAP_CAP. Stamp help category pages from the newest article date in the category.

verify.note: Fails on 2026-11-16: the commerce sections are still capped. Passes when the cap constant is gone because the readers page.
